about: Where the ledger's cited places open: each cited paper's public PDF (url) and the page, in that PDF, of each place the paper cites in it, so that a click on 'Eqn. (A21) of Shu (1984)' opens the whole paper in a new tab at that page (url#page=N; the browser's PDF viewer honors it). Locators are kind:number, the first number of a range. Shu (1984) is ADS's scan, identical to papers/shu84.pdf and read by eye. The Hahn papers are their arXiv versions, whose pages differ from the journal's (joes_papers/); their place numbers match the journal's, except that arXiv numbers H25's Eqn. (C1) as (C14). Borderies-Rappaport & Longaretti (1994) has no public copy, so its link opens its DOI with no page (nopage). tools/ledger_cards.py warns about any locator missing here.
